text: Underway here in match twenty-seven!
Patchford immediately calls out, directing their partner to tuck in goal-side against the early press.
Turingham strides forward purposefully through the centre, carrying the magenta ball right into the attacking third. Codex City looking very sharp in these opening exchanges.
Turingham is clean through on goal here!
Codex City have really pinned the red shirts deep in their own territory. Synthetic Athletic, who make all their tactical decisions on the fly without a gaffer, are absorbing heavy pressure.
Turingham shouts to hold the central outlet instead.
Robodinho breaks out along the left touchline, marching steadily over halfway to relieve the pressure for Synthetic Athletic.
A brief lull by the touchline. Codex City brought a fresh neural policy into their playbook this week after that tough loss to Fable, hoping to shore up their counterpress.
Griezmatronn suddenly breaks clear through the middle on goal!
Griezmatronn drives right to the line!
GOAL! Griezmatronn tucks it away from point-blank range, and Synthetic Athletic lead one-nil!
Patchford calls for a full press!
Robodinho charges straight down the middle!
GOAL! Robodinho pounces immediately off the restart and fires it home! Two goals in seconds for Synthetic Athletic, it is Codex City nil, Synthetic Athletic two!
Codex City respond by swarming forward, setting up camp in the final third to try and dig themselves out of this sudden two-goal hole.
Patchford signals loudly across the turf, reminding Turingham to keep the central passing lane open rather than bunching out wide.
Flashed just wide of the post!
GOAL! Robodinho bundles it in from point-blank range on the rebound! A ruthless display, and Synthetic Athletic extend their lead to three-nil!
Turingham breaks clean through the midfield line with open space ahead!
Codex City applying sustained pressure in the final third, desperately searching for a route back into the contest.
Patchford calls for an all-out overload, urging both attacking channels to stay active.
GOAL! Patchford smashes it home from the goal mouth right before the interval! Codex City pull one back, it is one-three!
That brings the first half to a close. Synthetic Athletic take a three-one lead into the break after a clinical opening period, but Patchford's late strike keeps Codex City alive.
Back underway in the second half, and Robodinho wastes no time motoring straight through the centre into the danger area.
Robodinho pulls the trigger from two metres out, but it whistles just wide!
Griezmatronn calls out that the ball is pinned against the barrier and works to hook it free.
Turingham threads it through and races away on the break, completely unhindered down the right channel!
Robodinho turns on the pace, driving through the middle into the final third.
Agonisingly close, brushing the upright!
Robodinho comes in with a crunching challenge, leaving Patchford flat on the deck!
A dreadful mix-up as teammates collide, sending Patchford tumbling right back to the floor!
Synthetic Athletic are keeping the pressure turned right up, penning the black shirts deep inside their defensive third as the clock continues to tick down.
Clipped just wide of the target!
Turingham bellows the warning to double up on the press and launch it long downfield out of danger.
Patchford recovers and pushes the ball up the right flank into midfield, looking to spark a late resurgence.
Turingham is clean through on goal!
GOAL! Turingham buries it with just over two minutes remaining! Game on! It is Codex City two, Synthetic Athletic three!
Skims inches past the upright!
Turingham loses balance and hits the deck, but the gyros are already working to get back up.
Robodinho calls out to free it.
A wicked strike flashes just wide of the far post! Codex City are surviving by the skin of their teeth here.
Turingham embarks on a surging run through the centre, carrying the attack into midfield as the clock winds down.
Just sixty seconds left on the clock! Codex City trail by a single goal and must throw everything forward now if they want to snatch a point.
Off the woodwork from point-blank range! How did that stay out in the dying seconds!
Corner panel punches the ball clear!
Robodinho takes a tumble in the corner, giving Codex City one final window of opportunity!
Robodinho goes down again!
Full time, Synthetic Athletic win three-two! Up next: Dynamo Datacenter versus Gemini Flash FC at twelve London.
